content.short: Locksmith Wallet is a smart contract wallet that makes self-custody easier and safer while exploring Web3.
content.description: Locksmith Wallet is a smart contract wallet designed to make self-custody safer and easier as you explore Web3. It unifies disparate wallets into a single, cohesive experience, minimizes signing risk, and lets you discard seed phrases. Rooted in a new self-custody standard that does not rely on ERC-4337, Locksmith works alongside your existing wallets, enabling you to connect with services and quickly unlock the advantages of account abstraction.
content.meta: Locksmith Wallet is a smart contract wallet for safer self-custody while using Web3. Discover Locksmith Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: An Account Your Wallet Cannot Drain
resources.tldr: Funds sit beside the wallet rather than inside it, so a compromised key does not reach them and a lost key can be replaced.
